topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Night's a blanket I pull tight, but the cold slips through. Found out Eve's been scripting our life, page by twisted page. Novel heart to heart, she calls it. More like a map of lies, each chapter a road we never took. Thought I knew every inch of her. Guess I was wrong. Books can close, but this? Stays open, bleeding truth onto the linoleum of my life. Didn’t expect this, a story where I'm the side character in my own existence. Rain's just a mirror for the tears I ain't crying. What’s a man to do when his world’s turned to ink and paper? Guess I find the next chapter, start writing where she left off.
